messages.text: Account team needs one defensible decision for duplicate EDI release on SO-47005 by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside customer PO, line, revision, quantity, and ship window must all duplicate an existing release.
I found 103 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for remaining valid demand coverage is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-006 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-005.

Required closeout records: send the scoped completion reply in the existing email thread; and record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
